author: Copilot
body: `used_capacity` is derived from `series_data.now[-1]`, but `now` is explicitly handled as potentially unsorted elsewhere (`preprocess_chart_data` sorts by timestamp). If `now` arrives unsorted from NOC, this can report an incorrect current usage. Derive `used_cap` from the max timestamp entry (or reuse the sorted/aggregated result) instead of the last list element.

author: Copilot
body: `parse_licensed_capacity` can raise a `ValueError` on `float(match.group(1))` because the regex `([\d.]+)` allows values like `1.2.3` that still match. Tighten the regex to a valid numeric format (e.g., one optional decimal point) and/or wrap the float conversion in a try/except and return 0.0 on parse failure to avoid 500s on unexpected NOC values.

author: Copilot
body: `licensed` and `now` use mutable list defaults (`=[]`). In this codebase's Pydantic DTOs, list fields are typically declared with `Field(default_factory=list[...])` to avoid shared mutable defaults and to satisfy linters. Switch these fields to `Field(default_factory=...)` for consistency and safety.

author: dmunagavalasa
body: When the regex doesn't match [new_value] (e.g. an unexpected unit like MB), the function returns 0.0 silently. Add a log.warning("Unable to parse licensed capacity value: %s", last_entry.new_value) before the return 0.0 so operators can spot bad data from NOC.

author: dmunagavalasa
body: [max(relevant, key=lambda e: e.date)](vscode-file://vscode-app/Applications/Visual%20Studio%20Code.app/Contents/Resources/app/out/vs/code/electron-browser/workbench/workbench.html) relies on lexicographic ordering. author: Copilot
body: `_build_monthly_points` no longer sorts `series_now` (or the resulting months) and returns `list(monthly_usage.items())`, so chart point ordering (and which value is treated as “last value wins” when upstream ordering changes) becomes dependent on NOC’s input order. This also conflicts with `preprocess_chart_data`’s docstring step that says raw telemetry is sorted by timestamp. Restore deterministic sorting here (timestamp and/or month key) or update the docstring and add a test that enforces the NOC ordering guarantee.
